title: Enforcement Actions against Illegal Subletting or Overcrowding in HDB Flats
what_it_is: Enforcement Actions against Illegal Subletting or Overcrowding in HDB Flats

sections.label: HDB illegal subletting enforcement
sections.summary: HDB took enforcement action in 70 cases over three years for unauthorised subletting and/or overcrowding, and works with Police, ICA and MOM.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) in the past three years, how many enforcement actions have been taken by HDB on illegal subletting and/or overcrowding in HDB flats; and (b) what are the measures that the Ministry is taking to ensure that all HDB flat owners comply with the regulation, including inter-Ministry joint collaboration.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: However, HDB flat owners can sublet their flat after meeting the required minimum occupation period (MOP) and obtaining HDB's prior approval.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: HDB takes a serious view of unauthorised subletting and/or overcrowding.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: When letting out the flat, flat owners have to ensure that the number of sub-tenants does not exceed the allowable maximum, which varies with flat type.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Failure to obtain prior approval or observe the maximum number of sub-tenants allowed is a breach of the Lease Agreement, and action can and will be taken against the errant flat owners.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: In the last three years, there were 70 cases where enforcement action was taken against errant flat owners for unauthorised subletting and/or overcrowding.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: HDB itself also conducts its own random checks on flats, and works with agencies like the Police, the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA) or the Ministry of Manpower (MOM), when there are suspected infringements under the Penal Code or relevant Acts under these agencies.

sections.label: Reviewing HDB occupancy numbers
sections.summary: The Ministry continues to review the number of occupants in HDB flats and will consider the Member's suggestion on lease duration.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: That is something that we continue to review.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, whether or not we should review the number of occupants, which is something that we are reviewing already.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: This follows from the earlier discussion we had in this House on the Planning Act changes and several Members had suggested that the numbers in the HDB flats ought to be reduced further.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We are studying that and we can take into consideration the Member's suggestion also on duration of lease.
